chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) in rousing the people to Syria [after he had finished with the matter of the Khawarij] [In it, he expresses his displeasure with the people, and advises them towards the right path:]
ai.seo_question: What was the context and purpose of Imam Ali's sermon to the people of Syria?
ai.summary: Delivered shortly after the Battle of Nahrawan, this sermon marks the transition from internal consolidation to the external conflict with Muawiya, reflecting Imam Ali’s strategic urgency. It underscores the theological and political necessity of the campaign while critiquing the Companions' wavering resolve, a key theme in Shia historiography regarding the legitimacy of the Caliphate.
